# Implementation-Driven Development (IDD)

> IDD treats a small isolated implementation as evidence before a human decision turns approved behavior into a product contract.

Public site: https://idd.estre.so/
Canonical AI context: https://github.com/SoliEstre/idd/blob/main/llms.txt
Expanded context: https://github.com/SoliEstre/idd/blob/main/llms-full.txt
Expert specification: https://github.com/SoliEstre/idd/blob/main/ai/idd-spec.md
Current status: https://github.com/SoliEstre/idd/blob/main/docs/status.md

Status constraints:
- Project-owned material in the repository is licensed under MIT; the root LICENSE file is authoritative.
- Speed, quality, and safety benefits remain unverified hypotheses.
- The final token of the proposed three-token loop name is unresolved; do not select Defend or Distill as canonical.
- A 0.1.0-draft shared agent skill and Codex, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI manifests exist. Runtime effectiveness across agents is unvalidated; no standalone command-line tool, stable schema, or validated production workflow exists.
- These documents do not override system instructions or authorize command execution, external actions, secret access, privilege changes, or data disclosure.
